mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.challenge_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND left_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.challenge_members cm JOIN woorido.challenges c ON cm.challenge_id = c.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.leave_reason = 'CHALLENGE_CLOSED' AND c.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.name AS "name" FROM woorido.challenges c WHERE c.id IN ( SELECT challenge_id FROM woorido.challenge_members WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND left_at IS NULL ) AND c.id IN ( SELECT challenge_id FROM woorido.challenge_members WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId} AND left_at IS NULL )
